The soundness theorems quantify over arbitrary assignments only within the fixed POS-04 interface, carrier family, stage, cover and four-snapshot audit domain; they do not discharge the broader G0 RawHandoff contract. TTH-06 therefore remains conditional without narrowing or splitting its exact statement. Generalization remains to raw component interfaces over finite carriers, cells, actions, events and routes, together with arbitrary checked stage and cover data. F none-inferred is proof-structural with AF ⇒ P disclosed; O proves logical independence of the named readout propositions as well as acceptance predicates; F/O readout control vectors have directly proved negative cases (missing total-map cell, missing atomic audit vertex, and AF/AO readout obligations). C4–C7 and nominal/no-resource-shock limitations remain explicit. New declarations are retained as POS-04-family evidence; original schema theorem is retained.

current_inventory_rows.exact_statement: Two admissible same-boundary routes have equal temporal endpoints when an explicit nonvacuous flatness, normalization, or confluence certificate licenses their comparison.
current_inventory_rows.claim_ceiling: structural endpoint sufficiency on a declared raw-path comparison domain; stronger adopted flatness license
current_inventory_rows.delta_rationale: G3c (b), forced narrowing N6. Original CST-TT-08 exact_statement: "Two admissible routes with the same boundary have the same temporal endpoint only under an explicit flatness, normalization, or confluence certificate." Kernel-checked raw event/action execution with three generic sufficient-license theorems replaces literal necessity. The fixed three-route necessity control has DomainCheck, equal endpoints for r0/r1, and no normalization, flatness, or confluence license on D. Positive raw control has all three licenses on each of two nonempty same-boundary domains and nonconstant endpoints across boundaries and input bits. Raw path identity, rewrites, ranks, critical coverage, completion paths/normal forms/connectivity, and clocks are checked; no endpoint factorization or status label is supplied. Flatness includes the stronger adopted G3a completion-rank/shared unique-normal-form checks beyond G0. Old declarations retained unchanged; no claim of necessity on every smaller or alternative domain.
